items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I made that tribute to Lunceford with Billy May. Billy May transcribed all the arrangements off the records... And in the meantime, I was doing all the rest of this studio work -- jingles and record dates and Nelson Riddle and Billy May and you name it

ctx.x: I'd say, "What are you talkin' about, man. I love that way that guy sang." Dan Grissom. I heard him, I played the piano for him in Seattle one night. He sang... [SINGS... DE/I love you...] -- "At Dawning." Whew! You could have heard a pin drop in that joint. It was an after-hours joint. When he got through with that, there was just utter silence. Finally, somebody says, "WSHEW!" You know?

I made that tribute to Lunceford with Billy May. Billy May transcribed all the arrangements off the records, note for note. Perfect. And when we got to the record date, Joe Thomas was there -- we had sent for some guys. You know, they got Willie and they got Joe...
